title: 【直播】原油別亂追！揭密荷姆茲斷供真相與華爾街隱藏時間表｜我的 3 個高 EV 策略
executive_summary: The video discusses the impact of the Hormuz Strait supply disruption on crude oil markets, the hidden timeline of Wall Street's options market bets, and the speaker's high EV (expected value) strategy configurations.
notable_claims: The speaker claims to reveal the true impact of the Hormuz Strait disruption, distinct from media-driven panic narratives.
They discuss the strategic importance of understanding inventory levels, alternative pipelines, and policy reactions in sustaining market stability.
The speaker critiques the strategy of 'blindly buying USO' and instead shares their preferred high EV trade ideas.
notable_opinions: The speaker expresses skepticism towards certain investment strategies, such as '無腦買 USO' (blindly buying USO).
They emphasize the importance of relying on mathematical strategies over intuition and fear in trading decisions.
